acceptanceCriteria: two PRs that each add a BUILD-LOG entry and a decision row merge without manual conflict resolution
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 merge queue. Every parallel PR adds a BUILD-LOG entry at the top and a decisions/README row, so each merge conflicts with the next (PRs #210-#223 needed an integration PR and a union resolver). Options: per-entry files under docs/build-log/ with a generated index, a union merge driver in .gitattributes, or append-only ordering. Related: V1-0237 (citation shifts), V1-0271.

holds.reason: Owner decision: how parallel PRs avoid conflicts in BUILD-LOG, decisions README and REQUIREMENTS (lane report 2026-10-22).

title: docs: parallel PRs conflict on every BUILD-LOG, decisions README and REQUIREMENTS.tsv append
